svg.text: XIAO RP2040 → HuskyLens Pro (breadboard, HuskyLens powered from XIAO 5V)
• TX and RX cross over: HuskyLens T goes to XIAO RX (D7), and R goes to XIAO TX (D6).
• Wire colours are DFRobot's usual ones. Check them against the T/R/GND/VCC labels on the HuskyLens board.
• Each breadboard row (a–e or f–j) is one connected strip, so any free hole in a pin's row works.
• On the HuskyLens: Settings → Protocol Type → Serial, 9600 baud. Laptop USB powers both boards.
• Don't connect servos or the external 5 V supply to this 5V pin.
